about: Retained events (plugins.md C2; Capacitor retainUntilConsumed, 36564ef): links and taps that come before the page listens. ops: [listen, name, whether the listener accepts], [unlisten, name], [emit, value, retain]; log: "name:value" for each delivery a listener accepted. A live event goes to every listener; one no listener accepted is kept when retained (at most 16, the oldest go) and replayed, in order, to the next listener, once.
